description: This file contains unit tests for the MySQLBooleanType class, verifying its behavior with different database implementations and ensuring it has a higher priority than a generic BooleanType.

classes.name: MySQLBooleanTypeTest
classes.description: Test class for the MySQLBooleanType, containing tests for database type conversion and priority.

methods.name: shouldReturnTinyIntForMySQLDatabase
methods.description: Verifies that MySQLBooleanType converts to TINYINT(1) for MySQLDatabase.

methods.name: shouldDelegateToLiquibaseDatabases
methods.description: Checks that MySQLBooleanType correctly delegates to various supported Liquibase database implementations.

methods.name: shouldHaveHigherPriority
methods.description: Ensures that MySQLBooleanType has a higher priority than the general BooleanType.
